title: From Generation to Judgment: Opportunities and Challenges of LLM-as-a-Judge
authors_zh: Dawei Li, Bohan Jiang, Liangjie Huang, Alimohammad Beigi, Chengshuai Zhao, Zhen Tan, Amrita Bhattacharjee, Yuxuan Jiang, Canyu Chen, Tianhao Wu, Kai Shu, Lu Cheng, Huan Liu
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Top-conference survey mapping judge inputs, outputs, benchmarks, and reliability risks.
以输入输出、方法、基准三维分类，系统梳理 LLM judge 的用途与可靠性风险。
why: It maps where LLM judges are used and which biases, vulnerabilities, and benchmarking gaps constrain their reliability.
inclusion_reason: Systematic review of LLM judge designs, evaluation benchmarks, and reliability risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reference matching and small learned metrics struggle with open-ended quality, safety, and reasoning assessment. LLM judges scale scoring, ranking, and selection, but their use has expanded faster than shared definitions, evaluation protocols, and reliability controls.

This survey organizes LLM-as-a-judge research by what is assessed, how a judge is built or prompted, and how it is benchmarked. It supplies a field map for auditing where judges enter the model-development lifecycle and where bias or vulnerability can invalidate their outputs.

基于参考匹配和小型学习模型的指标难以处理开放式质量、安全与推理评估。LLM judge 可以规模化地打分、排序和选择，但其应用扩张快于共享定义、评测协议和可靠性控制。

本文按评什么、怎样构建或提示 judge、怎样基准测试来组织研究，为审计 judge 在模型开发生命周期中的位置，以及偏差或脆弱性何时会使输出失效，提供领域地图。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey defines an LLM judge through input and output: it receives one or more candidates plus context and instruction, then produces scores, rankings, or selections. Its taxonomy links six judged attributes, ten methodology families, and four benchmark types. The central object is an evaluation protocol rather than a new dataset or training method. The authors release a maintained paper list and website; the survey's contribution is a structured map that makes judge reliability, benchmark coverage, and deployment roles comparable.
调研从输入、输出定义 LLM judge：它接收一个或多个候选、上下文和指令，再输出分数、排序或选择。分类连接六类被评属性、十类方法和四类基准。核心对象是评估协议，而不是新数据集或训练法。作者发布维护中的论文列表和网站；贡献是结构化地图，使 judge 可靠性、基准覆盖和部署角色可比较。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define judge I/O: point-wise input has one candidate; pair/list-wise input compares two or more. Outputs are score, ranking, or selection.
  1. Classify the target attribute: helpfulness, safety and security, reliability, relevance, logical quality, or overall quality.
  1. Classify the method: the survey groups manual or synthetic feedback, SFT, preference learning, swapping, rules, multi-agent collaboration, demonstrations, multi-turn interaction, and comparison acceleration.
  1. Classify benchmarks by general performance, bias quantification, challenging tasks, or domain-specific performance.
  1. Synthesize challenges and directions. Reusers should inspect the cited benchmark protocol, judge prompt, candidate order, and human reference before carrying a taxonomy label into an evaluation claim.

1. 定义 judge 输入输出：point-wise 输入一个候选，pair/list-wise 比较两个或更多；输出为分数、排序或选择。
  1. 分类目标属性：有用性、安全与安全性、可靠性、相关性、逻辑质量和总体质量。
  1. 分类方法：人工或合成反馈、SFT、偏好学习、交换操作、规则、多智能体协作、示例、多轮交互、比较加速。
  1. 分类基准：通用性能、偏差量化、挑战任务、领域特定性能。
  1. 综合挑战与方向。复用者应核对原始基准协议、judge 提示、候选顺序和人类参照，再将分类标签用于评估结论。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The survey does not claim a new trained-model score. Its evidence is coverage: it gives a formal I/O definition, six attribute classes, ten methodology families, and four benchmark categories, then connects them to applications in alignment, retrieval, reasoning, self-evolution, and agent decision-making. This supports the claim that LLM judging is a broad development component rather than only an NLG metric. It cannot prove that any named judge is reliable; that requires the underlying benchmark, human agreement, and adversarial tests.
该调研不主张新的训练模型分数，其证据是覆盖面：给出正式输入输出定义、六类属性、十类方法、四类基准，并把它们连接到对齐、检索、推理、自进化和智能体决策。这支持 LLM judging 是广泛开发组件而不只是 NLG 指标的结论；但不能证明任一具体 judge 可靠，后者仍需原始基准、人类一致性与对抗测试。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier surveys focus on LLM evaluation of NLG. This work expands the unit of analysis to the judge as a reusable system component, covering input/output formats, training or prompting methods, benchmark types, and downstream uses beyond evaluation. Its novelty is the three-dimensional taxonomy and the connection from generation to judgment across the development lifecycle. It does not introduce a new judge, a new ground-truth dataset, or a controlled reliability experiment.
既有调研聚焦 LLM 对 NLG 的评估。本文把 judge 作为可复用系统组件，覆盖输入输出格式、训练或提示方法、基准类型及超越评估的下游使用。新意是三维分类，以及从生成到判断、贯通开发生命周期的连接。它没有提出新 judge、新真值数据集或受控可靠性实验。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The taxonomy aggregates a fast-moving literature, so individual results, model versions, and benchmark status can become stale. It also describes bias and vulnerability but cannot resolve them experimentally. A category label such as “reliability” does not establish calibration, robustness to prompt injection, position bias, or human agreement. Reuse should trace every practical claim back to its source experiment and add task-specific adversarial testing.
分类汇总的是快速变化的文献，具体结果、模型版本和基准状态会过时。它也描述偏差和脆弱性，却不能实验性解决它们。“可靠性”一类标签不能证明校准、抗提示注入、位置偏差或人类一致性。复用时应把实际主张追溯到原始实验，并加入任务特定的对抗测试。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An evaluation designer can use the taxonomy to specify a judge contract: attribute, I/O format, method, benchmark category, and reliability tests. The inputs are candidate outputs, task context, a rubric, and a chosen judge; the output is a documented scoring, ranking, or selection protocol. It is useful for identifying missing bias or domain tests before deployment. Do not treat the survey as an implementation recipe or select a judge solely from its category without validating it on the intended task.
评估设计者可用该分类明确 judge 契约：属性、输入输出格式、方法、基准类别和可靠性测试。输入是候选输出、任务上下文、rubric 和选定 judge，输出是有文档的打分、排序或选择协议。它适合在部署前发现缺少的偏差或领域测试；不能把调研当作实现配方，也不能仅凭类别选择 judge 而不在目标任务上验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: LLM judges are development components, not merely open-ended generation metrics.
  • Method: classify judge I/O, six attributes, ten methods, and four benchmark families.
  • Artifact: official paper, maintained website, and paper list are available; this is a survey rather than a new dataset.
  • Evidence anchor: the taxonomy spans alignment, retrieval, reasoning, and agent applications, while retaining reliability risks.
  • Reuse decision: write a judge contract and adversarial test plan before trusting any survey-cited method.

• 定位：LLM judge 是开发组件，而不只是开放式生成指标。
  • 方法：分类 judge 输入输出、六类属性、十类方法和四类基准。
  • 数据与材料：官方论文、维护网站和论文列表可用；这是调研而非新数据集。
  • 证据锚点：分类跨越对齐、检索、推理和智能体应用，并保留可靠性风险。
  • 复用决定：信任任一调研方法前，先写 judge 契约和对抗测试计划。
